text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"mkdir -p /tmp/exposed-wheel-restore && cat > /tmp/exposed-wheel-restore/design-sol.md <<'EOF'
# Wheel restoration sketch

Read architect SKILL.md, Codex mapping, and design red flags. This is one read-only design runner; no nested panel or implementation.

## Grounding

`rankings.ts` supplies category identity, accent, glyph, local sector geometry and label placement; `CategoryWheel` owns SVG painting, clipped native buttons, selection and focus. Current geometry has companies bottom-left and parties bottom-right. Icons use exhaustive `IconName` + glyph map. Gallery is another wheel caller. Page explicitly sets 220px; retain it. No financial logic needs changes.

## Two contracts

A. Add mandatory `rimPath: string` beside existing `path` in `CategoryWheelOption`. Component paints full path with permanently tinted fill/fine outline, then overlays rimPath with fill none. Selected rim is brightest/thickest; others are muted. Full geometry remains caller-owned, consistent with current README. Cost: each caller repeats exact outer arc already embedded in path, creating a hand-synced geometric invariant; arbitrary mismatches compile.

B. Component owns quadrant geometry. Replace path/left/top/x/y with `quadrant: "top-left" | "top-right" | "bottom-left" | "bottom-right"`. A private exhaustive record defines each quadrant's path, rimPath, offsets and label coordinates. Features supply only identity/label/icon/accent/quadrant. Component uses one resolved geometry for fill, rim, clip and labels. Cost: explicit four-quadrant wheel contract replaces arbitrary-sector capability; no evidence callers need arbitrary geometry.

## Pick B

It gives the smaller public interface and keeps the geometric invariant in the rendering component that owns it. It removes six caller geometry fields instead of adding another coordinated string. The four private geometry entries preserve the existing exact paths and their outer arc prefixes; no parsing of SVG path strings or runtime trig is needed. This also prevents category identity from accidentally selecting geometry.

Usage: `<CategoryWheel options={rankingCategories} selected={selected} onselect={selectCategory} label="Ranking category" size={220} />`.

Type: `CategoryWheelOption<Id> = { id: Id; label: string; icon: IconName; accent: EntityAccent; quadrant: WheelQuadrant }`. Keep `WheelQuadrant` private unless callers need to name it separately.

Mapping: members/group/member/top-left; individuals/person/funder/top-right; parties/flag/neutral/bottom-left; companies/building/funder/bottom-right. Add `flag` and `chart` glyphs exhaustively to IconName/glyphs. Center chart is component-owned decoration, muted neutral and aria-hidden, with no pointer interaction. Keep native button pressed semantics and full-sector focus outline. No tick.

## Painting

Use explicit classes (`sector`, `sector-rim`, `focus-outline`) so the generic current `path` rule cannot fill the open rim or affect icon paths. Every sector gets subtle accent fill and fine accent-mixed outline in all states. Only rim selection changes emphasis: muted thin outer arc otherwise, saturated thicker selected arc; inner/straight boundaries remain fine. Buttons and icons inherit their accent in every state. Increase icon/label source sizes enough to remain readable after 220/284 scaling (e.g. 26px icon and 17px label), keeping labels within annular sectors. Center chart stays within the existing approximately 120px hole.

## Verification surface

Migrate both rankings and gallery callers and document changed geometry ownership. Check TS/build; exercise all four selections and keyboard focus in gallery/feature tests. Visually inspect 220px wheel: exact quadrant mapping, no tick, permanent fills, selected outer arc only, readable labels, neutral center. Desktop screenshot belongs in PR attachment, never repository.
EOF","max_output_tokens":1000}));

content.text:
Saved [design-sol.md](/tmp/exposed-wheel-restore/design-sol.md).

Recommend component-owned quadrant geometry: replace six caller geometry fields with `quadrant`, keeping exact sector/rim paths together privately. This avoids duplicated outer-arc geometry. Sketch covers category placement, icons, permanent tints, selected rim emphasis, center chart, and verification.
